examples.explanation: Ascending order is [3,7,9,15,20]. The first two next calls give 3 and 7; values remain so hasNext is 1; next gives 9; values remain so 1; next gives 15; one value (20) remains so 1.
One value remains (1), next returns 1, then nothing remains (0).
An empty tree has no next value.

hints: Flatten the tree once with an inorder walk to get ascending values, then serve operations with an index pointer.
Alternatively push left children onto a stack and expand right subtrees lazily for O(h) memory.
